build.summary: I built pci-lab-shell-session. The PCI lab now runs on the full-screen LabLayout (lab="pci") through a new PciLabSession: header, live monitor, reference monitor with QCA, haemodynamic monitor, dose panel, table strip and table-side controls. Imaging happens only while a pedal is held. The old 900 ms of automatic fluoroscopy after each action is gone. Cine runs and "store fluoro" go to the reference monitor through the same helpers the diagnostic lab uses. Each new, repeated or launched case gets a fresh patient, dose and syringes. A hand-over from the full case keeps that case's own patient. The lab takes a pending launch (scenario, variant, start, mode) on mount. The old keys still work through usePciInput.ts, plus three new ones: C (cine pedal), N (store fluoro) and Space now holds the cine pedal for the run. Device drawing moved unchanged from AngioPci.tsx into render/core.ts, composed by pciDevicesRender.ts. AngioPci.tsx is now a thin wrapper that re-exports pciDevices, pciFlowMods and NO_REFLOW_SCALE. Device consoles are found by glob from src/ui/pci/consoles/. The assisted console uses the old load path in every mode and is opened from a new table-side "Devices" tab. 3.75 p/s is added to PulseRate (adrc.ts and useSimulatorStore.ts) and to the PCI dose panel and imaging controls. The session records every console or dialogue it opens as a 'ui' event. It also exports a snapshot(), a tip context with 'plan' and 'finish' phases plus a held 'high-radiation-dose' event, and `raises`. All 16 listed files were snapshotted first. Every new and touched test file passes and the typecheck is clean, except two assertions in another package's controls.test.ts (see outOfScope). The realism re-capture (set pls1) scores 189 of 236, the same as the baseline, with no rows lost.

findings.where: src/ui/pci/PciLiveMonitor.tsx loop (the `now - last < 1000 / PCI_FRAME_HZ` gate, about line 88) and src/ui/pci/PciLabSession.ts step() headless branch (line 893, `1 / PCI_FRAME_HZ`); beginRun line 732 and storeFluoro line 753
findings.problem: Frames are always acquired at a fixed 15 Hz, but stored runs are labelled with the selected rate (RunRecorder fps = cinePps, storeFluoroLoop fps = fluoroPps). RunRecorder and storeFluoroLoop set durationS = frames / fps, and the reference monitor plays back at fps. A 30 f/s cine run therefore plays at twice real speed with half its true duration. A 7.5 f/s run plays at half speed. A stored 3.75 p/s fluoroscopy loop is four times too long and four times too slow. The live image also refreshes at 15 Hz whatever pulse rate is set, so 3.75 and 7.5 p/s look exactly like 15. The live gate also has no tolerance: at 60 Hz rAF, 4 ticks (66.7 ms) often fall just short, so frames arrive at about 12 Hz while being labelled 15. The diagnostic lab (src/ui/sim/FluoroView.tsx lines 333-334) acquires at the acquisition rate.
findings.fix: Acquire at the rate in force, as FluoroView does. In PciLiveMonitor's loop: `const im = session.imagingControls(); const fps = mode === "cine" ? im.cineRate : im.pulseRate; if (now - last < 1000 / fps - 1) return;`. In PciLabSession.step() headless branch: `const fps = mode === "cine" ? (this.lab.exposure.cinePps ?? 15) : (this.lab.exposure.fluoroPps ?? 15); if (this.frameAcc >= 1 / fps - 1e-9) {...}`, and reset frameAcc to 1 / fps when the beam goes off. Dose stays correct, because LabImaging.expose books dose by elapsed time times pps. Add a test: set the cine rate to 7.5 and the fluoroscopy rate to 3.75, run 2 s of each, and assert the stored series' frames.length / fps is about 2 s.

findings.problem: The live table strip shows the latest PciState event text in every mode, exam included. Those texts carry ground truth that the operator would not be told: 'Wire across the lesion. Take it well into the distal vessel for support.', 'Geographic miss: the distal stent edge lands in diseased vessel.', 'The balloon covered only part of the lesion.', 'Balloon inflated away from the lesion.', 'Flow was already normal.'. labScreens already sets coachLine: false for every mode, and the builder's own notes say the event log is a guided-mode teaching aid. This breaks the no-ground-truth-on-live-screens rule.
findings.fix: Pass `showEvent={screens.teachingAids}` from PciLabScreen to PciTableStrip and render the status line only when it is true. The event log stays in the guided drawer's teaching-aid section. Alternatively drop the line from the strip entirely. Add a render test that shows no event text in exam or independent mode after a wire crossing.

review.verdict:
pci-lab-shell-session needs changes before it can be signed off. Most of the design is implemented and works, but I found 3 major and 9 minor problems.

What I checked and found sound:
- The 6 snapshotted shared files changed only as described. labSession.ts was refactored into startCineRun, storeFluoroLoop and storedMmPerPx with the same behaviour, and the diagnostic integration tests pass. adrc.ts and useSimulatorStore.ts only gained 3.75 in the PulseRate type, and DIAGNOSTIC_RATES is unchanged. LabLayout gained a `lab` prop defaulting to diagnostic, and DosePanel gained `rates` and `cineRates` props with the old defaults.
- The device drawing moved into render/core.ts unchanged apart from renamed lambda parameters (I diffed it), and the golden digests match.
- The other src files modified since .started (patient.ts, the planning files, PlantedProblems.tsx) are listed by other packages.
- I ran the 4 package test files myself: 28 of 28 pass. The typecheck is clean (exit 0). The neighbouring tests pass except the 2 controls.test.ts assertions the builder reported.
- Each new case gets a fresh session and the 900 ms automatic fluoroscopy is gone. Imaging is pedal-gated, with an X-ray release and a beam gate. Cine runs and store fluoro use the shared helpers. 'ui' events are recorded with their ids. The keys moved to usePciInput.ts unchanged. Consoles are discovered by glob, and the assisted path works in every mode. The `raises` export, the plan and finish phases and the held high-radiation-dose event are present, as are the __pci, __pciDraw, __pciStep, __pciSession and __lab.pci hooks. Per-frame allocations match the old lab and FluoroView.
- I did not repeat the browser checks or the realism re-capture; those rest on the builder's report.

The 3 major problems:
1. Stored runs have the wrong speed and duration. The lab acquires frames at a fixed 15 Hz but labels each stored run with the selected rate. A 30 f/s cine run plays at twice real speed, and a 3.75 p/s fluoroscopy loop plays four times too slowly. The live image also looks the same at every pulse rate.
2. Ground truth appears on a live screen. The table strip shows the latest procedure message in every mode, exam included, for example 'Wire across the lesion' or 'Geographic miss'.
3. controls.test.ts fails. The new Devices tab breaks 2 assertions in that file, which no package owns.

One acceptance criterion is not met. At phase 'plan', pci-rad-shallow-working-view ranks 33rd and does not reach tipsFor(ctx, 20). Fixing this needs a decision from the owners of tips.ts or pci-tip-context, and the test as written only asserts weaker facts.

The minor problems:
- The shared imaging tab offers a 3.75 cine rate that does nothing in the PCI lab.
- A new test asserts the known '3.8 p/s' label defect, so it will fail once that label is fixed.
- The reachability report does not yet read the session's `raises` export.
- The teaching-aid section is gated on guided mode instead of `teachingAids`.
- The stent's 10 atm nominal and 16 atm rated burst pressure are unsourced and unlabelled.
- The case brief shows the raw guide id ('EBU3.5') instead of the generic label.
- On each scenario change or repeat, the lab screen mounts once on the disposed old session.
- A full-case hand-over clears the patient's diagnostic runs from the reference monitor.

Exact fixes for each problem are listed in the findings.

Applied (all under /Users/qc25212/Downloads/Misc/Games and apps/Cath Simulator):

1. Frame rate (major). Frames are now taken at the rate in force: the cine frame rate during cine, the pulse rate during fluoroscopy. This is done in the live monitor loop in src/ui/pci/PciLiveMonitor.tsx (with 1 ms of slack, as FluoroView does) and in the headless step in src/ui/pci/PciLabSession.ts (new acquisitionRate(mode); the timer keeps its remainder, and the first frame after a pedal press comes at once).    - The fix exposed a second problem that the reviewer's claim "dose stays correct" missed. LabImaging.expose in src/render/xray/sceneBuilder.ts books at most 0.2 s of beam time per frame (MAX_EXPOSE_STEP_S), and a 3.75 p/s frame interval is 0.27 s.
